text:
Priya Singh: Heads up — new customer Orion requested onboarding for a 13B causal model, wants quantized int8 ASAP. They have sensitive PII so Private deployment preferred. Link to request: https://tickets.redwood/ORION-452 :eyes:
eng-ml-bot: [triage] label=onboarding priority=high submitted_by=Priya Singh
Alice Chen: Can we get basic acceptance criteria from CS? latency SLO, throughput, and eval suite.
Priya Singh: CS says target p99 latency <= 220ms at 1rps, top-1 QA gap <= 2% vs baseline. They also want story-based toxicity checks.
Raul Martinez: Priority = high but not emergency. Suggest run quant smoke (int8/q4f16) on a single A40 node first. If perf ok, schedule Dedicated run.
Tom O'Neill: Quick checklist I can run today:
```bash
# run smoke perf
rf serve --model orion-13b --weights /mnt/models/orion-13b/fp16 --quant int8 --batch 1 --seq 512 --profile
# run evals harness
python evals/run_suite.py --model /tmp/orion-13b-quant --suite storyqa,toxicity
```
Maya Gupta: I can provision a test VPC (us-west2) and a 1xA40 for the smoke. ETA 2 hours. :rocket:
Alice Chen: Also need sample prompts + reference outputs from the product team. @Priya can you ping them?
Priya Singh: Pinging product now. Also attaching minimal prompt set in slack thread.
eng-ml-bot: intake_form submitted. fields=[customer:Orion, model:orion-13b, sensitivity:high, deployment:private, priority:high]
Raul Martinez: If smoke fails on latency, fallback plan = enable KV cache + reduce seq to 256 then re-eval. Document perf delta.
Tom O'Neill: I'll try int8+KV first, then q4f16 if int8 accuracy regresses >2%. Keep logs in /runs/orion-1866401234.
Maya Gupta: Provisioned test VPC and attached A40. IP: 10.42.8.12
Alice Chen: Nice. Once smoke passes, schedule full quant ablation (batch sizes 1,4,8) and quality evals. Who owns rollout plan?
Priya Singh: I'll own rollout and customer comms. Plan: smoke -> ablation -> dedicated run -> canary -> handoff. Timeline target: 1 week.
Raul Martinez: Add perf dashboard tile and failure alert (p99>300ms) before canary. Also add model pin and automatic fallback to fp16 baseline.
Tom O'Neill: I'll drop initial run logs and a short runbook in the repo: infra/bringup/orion-13b/README.md
Priya Singh: Thanks team. Tagging this thread with #onboard and marking follow-ups in Spreadsheets. :white_check_mark:
Maya Gupta: On it. Will update when ablation starts.
eng-ml-bot: Reminder set for 1866480000 (24h) to check status.
Priya Singh: closing loop here later today with preliminary results. Thanks everyone.
